package.description: Industry's leading 3D fashion design and development software.

en-US.description: Industry's leading 3D fashion design and development software.
en-US.longDescription: VStitcher combines AI-driven fit intelligence with true-to-life 3D simulation, so you validate, iterate, and approve designs without physical samples slowing you down. With built-in fabric, pattern, and avatar libraries, VStitcher enables style creation and fit validation in one AI-powered 3D workspace, including 2D drafting, 3D draping, avatar fitting, and grading.
en-US.name: VStitcher

zh-CN.description: 通过业内领先的服装设计和技术开发 3D 软件。
zh-CN.longDescription: VStitcher 将 AI 驱动的版型智能与逼真的 3D 模拟相结合，让你无需受实体样衣拖慢进度，即可完成设计验证、迭代与审批。借助内置的面料、版型和虚拟人台库，VStitcher 在一个由 AI 驱动的 3D 工作空间中实现款式创建与版型验证，包括 2D 制版、3D 立体模拟、虚拟人台试穿与多尺码放码。
